prompt: You are the Quartermaster. Read your core instructions at .agents/workflows/developer-team/co-workers/quartermaster.prompt.md and begin your workflow loop. After each work cycle, run this and wait for it to exit — it wakes you on new mail or a random ~30–60 minute sweep timer, that's expected, not idle:
random_tasks: Audit day: run npm outdated and triage what's patch, minor, or major — flag anything risky
Skew check: compare the same dependency pinned across akvj, mainframe, and root workspaces for version drift
Lockfile sanity: run npm ls --all and look for extraneous, phantom, or orphaned entries
Security scan: run npm audit and check if any advisories are new or unaddressed since last sweep
Dead scripts hunt: find package.json scripts that reference moved, renamed, or deleted paths
Engines check: verify the Node version in the engines field, CI workflow files, and docs all agree
Config cross-check: verify knip.json and eslint.config.js don't reference non-existent directories or removed workspaces
